thread:
maria: Heads-upwant to land a lightweight pattern for audit "compact" rows + on-demand full snapshots. Name: "surgical snapshots". Aim: cheap Console surface, full fidelity when needed.

maria: Proposal bullets:
- compact row: actor, time, delta keys, short justification snippet (no raw values)
- CTA: Request snapshot -> triggers export job that ties cryptographic proof_id to the change
- retention: snapshots kept X days depending on tenant tier, compact rows indefinite
- sampling: upstream policy assigns sample_score; higher scores keep precomputed snapshot copies

tom: Clarify: where do we sample? two options:
- sample-on-ingest: create snapshot at write time (fast later reads, more storage)
- sample-on-demand: create when user clicks (cheap storage, latency on request)
I think hybrid: precompute for score>70, on-demand otherwise.

sahil: Agree hybrid. Also: snapshot bundles must include "proof_sig" and provenance header so exported bundles can be verified by legal. We should compute an HMAC over change_id+timestamp+actor and store proof_token.

jen: UX: for compact rows we need clear affordances: small badge "compact" or "snapshot-ready" and a flyout that shows sample_reason and retention TTL. If snapshot exists show "Download" else show "Request snapshot (cost est)".

maria: Important: cost estimation in UI. We should call a price-estimate endpoint before user confirms. Example: GET /v2/audit/estimate?snapshot=true&change_id=... -> { est_bytes, est_cost_usd, est_eta_sec }

tom: API shape idea: POST /v2/audit/snapshots with body {change_id, requestor, mode: "adi-hoc|precomputed" , reason_hint } returns 202 + { job_id, queued_at, eta_seconds }. Job payload includes sample_origin tag for telemetry.

sahil: Telemetry: emit event "audit.snapshot.requested" with fields: tenant_id, change_id, origin, sample_score, precompute_flag, requester_role. Also emit "audit.snapshot.completed" with size_bytes, proof_id, duration_ms, success.

jen: Permissions flow: viewing compact rows = "audit.compact.view"; downloading snapshot = "audit.snapshot.download" + if snapshot contains PII then require "audit.pii.elevated" or an approval flow. Show consent modal when snapshot exposes PII and log consent event.

maria: Redaction: compact rows must never show raw PII. Instead show markers: "email: changed" or "phone: changed". Only snapshots can include values and only if requester has permission / consent.

tom: Quotas: tenants have monthly_budgeted_snapshot_bytes and per-tenant ad_hoc_concurrent_jobs limit. If over limit, POST should return 429 with link to quota status and optional opt-in to queued background job.

infra-bot: scheduled deployment: audit-exporter v3.0 -> canary at 2026-04-01T02:00Z :satellite:

jen: UX edgecases: if compact row points to multiple changes (batched change_id) UI should show aggregate CTA and aggregated cost. Also add a tiny "why sampled" tooltip (policy name + score) so investigators know why a snapshot existed before.

maria: Good. Also add TTL display: e.g. "Snapshot available for 5 days". If snapshot expired, show "Request new snapshot" and gray the older proof link.

sahil: For auditability: keep immutable proof entries in ledger service with proof_id -> change_id mapping. Export bundles carry proof_id and a signed manifest. This avoids tampering issues.

tom: Implementation tasks:
- infra: add precompute worker that triggers when sample_score >= threshold and tenant tier allows
- api: add /v2/audit/snapshots + estimate endpoint + job queue hook (202 + job id)
- quotas: quota check middleware + helpful 429 payload with next_available_eta

jen: I'll mock a small Console panel: compact row list + badge + request snapshot modal w/ est cost and consent checkbox.

maria: Sahil, can you draft the telemetry proto fields? Tom, can you sketch the API and the job payload? Jen, drop Figma. I'll write an RFC this afternoon.

maria: Target: canary in staging in two weeks. Any objections?

jen: No objections. I'll start the mock now.

tom: I'll prototype the POST and the 202 job flow on staging.

sahil: I'll add proof_id to the ledger and wire up the metrics.

maria: thanks all. If anyone hits policy blockers (legal/PII) ping me.
